body.statement:
Let every training-fold operator be formed from the support-cleaned matrices and use
\[
 \widehat N=I_{K^{2}}-\widehat D^{-1}\widehat B
 (\widehat B^{\mathsf T}\widehat D^{-1}\widehat B)^{+}\widehat B^{\mathsf T}.
\]
If, on every fold, \(R_{\Sigma}=o_P(1)\), \(\Delta_n=o_P(n^{-1/2})\),
\[
 r_{A,\infty}+r_{Z,\infty}=o_P(\tau_{S,n}),
 \qquad \tau_{S,n}=o(n^{-1/4}),
\]
then
\[
 \sqrt n(\widehat\psi-\psi)
 =n^{-1/2}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\phi^{\mathrm{eff}}(O_i)+o_P(1),
 \qquad
 \sqrt n(\widehat\psi-\psi)\rightsquigarrow N(0,V_{\mathrm{eff}}),
\]
and \(\widehat V_{\mathrm{eff}}\to_PV_{\mathrm{eff}}\).
body.justification: The theorem pairs the canonical bound with an attaining estimator and exposes the support-screening, threshold, stability, and product-rate requirements.
body.gap: Prior hidden-treatment limit theory does not cover the exact projected multilevel score with a non-oracle support-cleaned coherent fit.
body.consumer: It yields efficient standard errors for latent maternal-smoking exposure means when the declared separated-model diagnostics and cleaned rates hold.
body.proof_tex:
Because \(D\mathbf 1_{K^2}=Bw\), the projector algebra gives \(N\mathbf 1_{K^2}=0\).  Therefore \(Qv=0\) for every nonrandom vector \(v\in\mathbb R^K\), coordinatewise: both \(Nv\) and its Gram right-hand side vanish.  The canonical-gradient definition consequently gives \(U-QU=\psi+\phi^{\mathrm{eff}}\).  Set
\[
 S(O)=U(O)-QU(O)=\psi+\phi^{\mathrm{eff}}(O),
 \qquad \widehat S_f=\widehat U_f-\widehat Q_f\widehat U_f
\]
for training fold \(f\), and let \(n_f\) be its held-out size.  Adding and subtracting foldwise conditional means gives the exact decomposition
\[
\begin{aligned}
 \sqrt n(\widehat\psi-\psi)
={}&n^{-1/2}\sum_{i=1}^n\phi^{\mathrm{eff}}(O_i)\\
&+n^{-1/2}\sum_{f=1}^{F_{\mathrm{fold}}}
 \sum_{i:\,\mathrm{fold}(i)=f}
 \bigl[(\widehat S_f-S)(O_i)-P(\widehat S_f-S)\bigr]\\
&+n^{-1/2}\sum_{f=1}^{F_{\mathrm{fold}}}n_fP(\widehat S_f-\psi). \tag{13}
\end{aligned}
\]
Conditional on the training observations for fold \(f\), its held-out summands are independent and centered by the iid assumption, and the conditional second moment of the normalized fold sum is bounded by
\[
 \frac{n_f}{n}\|\widehat S_f-S\|_2^2. \tag{14}
\]
The established score-stability lemma and \(R_\Sigma=o_P(1)\) make (14) converge to zero in probability.  Conditional Markov inequality and the fixed number of folds therefore make the middle line of (13) \(o_P(1)\).

The condition \(r_{A,\infty}+r_{Z,\infty}=o_P(\tau_{S,n})\) invokes the support-cleaned quadratic-bias lemma on an event whose probability tends to one.  Consequently the last line of (13) is bounded in norm by
\[
 n^{-1/2}\sum_fn_f C_{\mathrm{reg}}\Delta_{n,f}
 \leq\sqrt n\,C_{\mathrm{reg}}\max_f\Delta_{n,f}=o_P(1), \tag{15}
\]
where the last equality uses the fixed number of folds and the stated foldwise product-rate condition.  Thus
\[
 \sqrt n(\widehat\psi-\psi)
 =n^{-1/2}\sum_{i=1}^n\phi^{\mathrm{eff}}(O_i)+o_P(1). \tag{16}
\]
The threshold requirement \(\tau_{S,n}=o(n^{-1/4})\) makes the cleaning contribution compatible with \(\Delta_n=o_P(n^{-1/2})\); the expansion itself uses the latter explicit condition.

The regularity margins, bounded outcome, fixed \(K\), and the Gram cutoff bound \(\|\widehat G_{\tau_G}^{\dagger}\|_{\mathrm{op}}\leq2/\varepsilon\) bound both the true and fitted scores uniformly by a constant depending only on the regular stratum.  In particular \(E_P\phi^{\mathrm{eff}}=0\) and its covariance is \(V_{\mathrm{eff}}\).  For fixed \(t\in\mathbb R^K\), the scalar Taylor formula for the complex exponential, with its uniformly bounded third-order remainder, gives
\[
 E_P\exp\{i t^{\mathsf T}\phi^{\mathrm{eff}}/\sqrt n\}
 =1-\frac{t^{\mathsf T}V_{\mathrm{eff}}t}{2n}+o(n^{-1}). \tag{17}
\]
Independence raises (17) to the \(n\)-th power, whose limit is \(\exp\{-t^{\mathsf T}V_{\mathrm{eff}}t/2\}\).  Applying this calculation to every fixed \(t\), and then (16), proves the asserted joint Gaussian limit.

For covariance consistency, score stability gives \(\widehat S_f\to S\) in \(L^2(P)\) on each fold.  Conditional on its training sample, independence and uniform boundedness give by a direct variance calculation
\[
 \left\|P_{n,f}(\widehat S_f\widehat S_f^{\mathsf T})
 -P(\widehat S_f\widehat S_f^{\mathsf T})\right\|_{\mathrm F}=o_P(1). \tag{18}
\]
Cauchy--Schwarz and \(L^2\) convergence give
\[
 \|P(\widehat S_f\widehat S_f^{\mathsf T})-P(SS^{\mathsf T})\|_{\mathrm F}
 \leq\|\widehat S_f-S\|_2(\|\widehat S_f\|_2+\|S\|_2)=o_P(1). \tag{19}
\]
Summing over the fixed folds and using (16), hence \(\widehat\psi\to_P\psi\), shows that the empirical covariance centered at \(\widehat\psi\) converges to
\[
 E_P\{(S-\psi)(S-\psi)^{\mathsf T}\}
 =E_P(\phi^{\mathrm{eff}}\phi^{\mathrm{eff},\mathsf T})
 =V_{\mathrm{eff}}.
\]
This proves all conclusions.
